text:
Alex: quick idea — want to run a small weekend spike simulation for inbound routing to see how claim latency and ownership skew behave under enrichment backpressure. goal is to validate round‑robin fairness tweaks and the heartbeat fallback. anyone available to pair later today?
Marta: i can help with the sim harness. what scenario? high concurrent leads + slow enrichment (~4s) or enrichment outage?
Alex: start with high qps + slow enrichment (4–6s) then do full enrichment outage. capture: time-to-first-claim, time-to-owner-ack, number of fallback assignments to default owner.
Devon: recommend also instrumenting HubSpot webhook retries and SF roundtrip latency. if HS retries pile up we’ll see duplicate attempts that confound claim metrics.
Sam: can we run two rr variants? current RR and a token-bucket softened RR that limits claim rate per-owner. want to compare fairness and SLA.
Alex: yes — run baseline RR and RR+cooldown. logging: include claim_event with owner_id, attempt_ts, assigned_at, enrichment_status.
Marta: adding a small config snippet for the token-bucket variant: ```
rr_variant: token_bucket
capacity: 5
refill_rate_per_min: 10
owner_cooldown_s: 30
```
Devon: for HubSpot mapping, add a test for missing owner metadata so we validate default-owner fallback path. also simulate timezone skew for EMEA owners.
Sam: i'll set up two canary runs (eu, na) and a weekend window (sat 02:00 local) to mimic reduced team availability. results should include a heatmap of claim latency by owner cohort.
leadops-bot: NOTE: automated simulation cluster scheduled for 2025-06-21T02:00Z. CI artifacts will land in /sim-results/inbound-sla-experiments/1748882024.
Alex: perfect. next steps: Marta & Sam kick off the config and run baseline today; Devon will create test hooks for HS retry/geo skew; i’ll draft the one‑page ask for sales ops with expected metrics and acceptance criteria.
Marta: on it, starting now. i’ll post raw logs to the channel and tag when ready. :thumbsup:
Devon: will add a quick smoke test for the SF webhook mapping.
Sam: ETA for first run ~3h. will share a short gist with run commands.
Alex: thanks team. keep it tight — we want actionable numbers for the handoff SLA playbook and to validate whether the token-bucket RR reduces owner thrash without increasing default-owner fallthrough.
